_comment: ARC config template — copy to the location shown by `arc auth show`
_note: Secrets (bearer_token, client_secret, ssh.password) are stored in the OS keychain or temporary env vars, not here

scm._note: Palo Alto SCM service accounts provide a client_id and client_secret — paste those values here. Use bearer_token only if you have a pre-issued token (not the typical service account flow). Secrets (bearer_token, client_secret) are stored in the OS keychain; run `arc auth configure` to store them securely rather than editing this file.
scm.client_id: your-scm-client-id (from the SCM service account — labelled 'Client ID' in the portal)
scm.tsg_id: your-scm-tsg-id (Tenant Services Group ID — shown alongside the service account in the SCM portal)

ssh._note: SSH credentials for managed PAN-OS devices. username is the login user (default: admin). Prefer key_path over password. password is stored in the OS keychain; run `arc auth configure` to set it.
